Hi Priyanka —

Thanks again for taking the time to interview with us. I wanted to lock in a proposed structure for the two-day virtual full-loop and confirm a few details so we can send calendar invites today. High-level plan below (attached is a slightly more detailed agenda v2):

Day 1 (technical focus) — 3 x 60min panels, 15–20 min break between panels
- 09:30–10:30 PT: Systems design (backend/serving)
- 10:50–11:50 PT: Model inference & latency optimization
- 12:10–13:10 PT: Engineering leadership / product alignment (short behavioral + roadmap)

Day 2 (cross-functional + exec) — 2 x 45min + 1 x 60min
- 09:30–10:15 PT: Product deep-dive / customer use-cases
- 10:30–11:15 PT: SRE / reliability & incident handling (45min)
- 11:30–12:30 PT: Final wrap / leadership conversation + Q&A

We want to reserve 30 minutes immediately after the last session each day for a debrief slot for interviewers (we'll send a short scribe template). Are there any constraints from your side about early starts or specific time windows? Also, do you need us to provide a quiet room (test Zoom link) or anything extra for accessibility?

Attachments: Priyanka_Sethi_resume.pdf, Virtual_Onsite_Agenda_v2.docx

Best,
Soojin Lee
